1.title: Chapter One: The Crawl

candidates.text: Steve, Robin, Jonathan, and Nancy work shifts at a small local radio station, slipping coded messages into their broadcasts.
candidates.grounded_in: Steve, Robin, Jonathan, and Nancy work at WSQK, a local radio station, where they relay coded messages to the group

candidates.text: The group has a nickname for their sneaking trips into the Upside Down: they call them "crawls."
candidates.grounded_in: opportunities to sneak Hopper into the Upside Down, which they call "crawls"

candidates.text: Hawkins sits under military quarantine, with soldiers having set up a base camp inside the Upside Down itself.
candidates.grounded_in: a contingent of the US military... have placed Hawkins under quarantine and created a base camp within the Upside Down

candidates.text: Eleven trains in hiding, kept out of sight with Hopper and Joyce while the search for her continues.
candidates.grounded_in: still on the hunt for Eleven, who trains in hiding with Hopper and Joyce

candidates.text: An opening flashback goes back to 1983, with Will hiding alone in the Upside Down.
candidates.grounded_in: While hiding in the Upside Down in 1983

1.note: Dustin's beating at Eddie's grave, the Demogorgon caravan attack and the gate in Holly's bedroom are all excluded as injuries/turning points; Dustin provoking the basketball team is the direct setup for the beating, so it was left out too.

2.title: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of Holly Wheeler

candidates.text: Tension boils over as Jonathan accuses Steve of quietly competing with him for Nancy's attention.
candidates.grounded_in: Jonathan accuses Steve of competing for Nancy's attention

candidates.text: Lucas keeps up his bedside vigil beside the comatose Max, still hoping that she will wake up.
candidates.grounded_in: Lucas continues tending to a comatose Max in hopes she will wake up

candidates.text: Robin floats the idea of putting Will's telepathic link to the hive mind to practical use.
candidates.grounded_in: Robin proposes using Will's telepathic link to Vecna's hive mind

candidates.text: Eleven and Hopper pick their way through the Upside Down side by side, searching as they go.
candidates.grounded_in: The two then search for Holly

3.title: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap

candidates.text: Erica is enlisted to drug a bullying classmate and his entire family at their home.
candidates.grounded_in: enlists Erica to drug Derek and his family

candidates.text: The group hauls an unconscious family out to an abandoned barn and lays them out there.
candidates.grounded_in: transporting the unconscious family to an abandoned barn

candidates.text: The teenagers unpack a stash of weapons that Murray smuggled past the quarantine into Hawkins.
candidates.grounded_in: The group arms themselves using weapons smuggled in by Murray

candidates.text: Hopper and Eleven work at the enormous wall ringing Hawkins, trying to find a way through it.
candidates.grounded_in: Hopper and Eleven fail to break through the massive wall

candidates.text: A suburban house is rigged and rearranged into a trap, with the kids waiting inside for the Demogorgon.
candidates.grounded_in: converting Derek's house into a trap for the Demogorgon

3.note: Holly's arrival in Henry's childhood home and who she meets there is the episode's reveal, so it is excluded.

candidates.text: Soldiers move through Hawkins rounding up children who might be next, holding them at the base camp.
candidates.grounded_in: the military detains children in Hawkins who could be potential victims

candidates.text: Holly has invented a name for the strange memory-world she and Max are stuck inside: "Camazotz."
candidates.grounded_in: a psychic realm made of Henry's memories, nicknamed "Camazotz" by Holly

candidates.text: Hopper and Eleven slip inside the military's base camp within the Upside Down, looking for who is being held there.
candidates.grounded_in: Hopper and Eleven infiltrate the military base

candidates.text: Dustin, Steve, Nancy, and Jonathan chase a Demogorgon away from the others and through a gate into the Upside Down.
candidates.grounded_in: Dustin, Steve, Nancy, and Jonathan chase it into the Upside Down

candidates.text: The group runs voltage from the radio tower through a dead Demogorgon's body, trying to jolt it back to life.
candidates.grounded_in: Will's group reanimates a dead Demogorgon using the radio tower's voltage so Will can reconnect to the hive mind

candidates.text: Max and Holly move through Henry's memories of Holly herself, hunting for a way out while Derek keeps him talking.
candidates.grounded_in: Max and Holly traverse Henry's memories of Holly to search for an escape as Derek distracts him

candidates.text: The kidnapped children wake up together, and most of them accept Henry's story that he rescued them.
candidates.grounded_in: the kidnapped children awaken, and while most believe Henry's claim that he saved them, Holly and Derek do not

candidates.text: Nancy and Jonathan climb up onto the roof of Hawkins Lab and find something strange sitting there.
candidates.grounded_in: Nancy and Jonathan find a mysterious sphere on the roof of the lab

6.title: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz

candidates.text: Erica and Murray turn up at their old science teacher's door, hoping he can help pinpoint where Dustin's group is.
candidates.grounded_in: Erica and Murray recruit Mr. Clarke to help locate Dustin's group.

candidates.text: Dustin tries to walk a baffled Steve through his theory about what the Upside Down actually is.
candidates.grounded_in: Dustin explains to Steve that the Upside Down is not an alternate dimension

candidates.text: At the hospital, Lucas and Robin keep watch over Max's bed, with Robin's girlfriend there too.
candidates.grounded_in: Lucas, Robin, and her girlfriend Vickie protect Max from the Demodogs

candidates.text: Max and Holly wander into one of Henry's old memories, a dark cave, while searching for a way out.
candidates.grounded_in: Max and Holly find a memory of a young Henry killing a man in self-defense in a cave.

6.note: Most of this episode's beats (the sphere detonation aftermath, the breakup, Karen's rescue, the escapes) are explicit turning points or outcomes, so the usable texture is limited.

7.title: Chapter Seven: The Bridge

candidates.text: Erica, Murray, and Mr. Clarke hunch over overlaid maps, pinpointing where Dustin's group sits on the other side.
candidates.grounded_in: Erica, Murray, and Mr. Clarke map Dustin's location in the Upside Down to the lab

candidates.text: The group studies the radio station's tower, planning a climb, and readies a timer-rigged bomb to carry with them.
candidates.grounded_in: climb the WSQK radio tower into the Abyss, rescue the children, and then destroy the Upside Down by detonating a time bomb near the exotic matter

candidates.text: Eleven strains and forces open a rift in the air so the separated groups can regroup at last.
candidates.grounded_in: Eleven opens a rift so the group can reunite

7.note: Most of this episode's beats are outcomes, reveals, or a confession, so safe material was thin.

8.title: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up

candidates.text: Eleven, Max and Kali go in together, travelling into Henry's mind side by side.
candidates.grounded_in: Eleven, Kali, and Max enter Henry's mind

candidates.text: Will finds himself watching scenes from Henry's childhood past unfold around him.
candidates.grounded_in: Will witnesses Henry's past

candidates.text: The rest of the group makes its way up and across toward the Abyss.
candidates.grounded_in: As the others make their way to the Abyss

8.note: Finale: nearly every moment in the summary is a death, rescue, reveal, arrest, engagement or epilogue, so safe texture is very limited.
